files.notes.md:
Relay completion design, implemented in staging.
Queue message carries job_id only. Claim transaction increments jobs.epoch, sets owner and lease_until using database time, returns epoch. Worker keeps this epoch. Renew needs matching owner and epoch and database now < lease_until. At exactly lease_until renewal fails. An expired worker may continue local computation; no process-kill guarantee. Another worker can claim after expiry and gets larger epoch. Complete updates result and status in one transaction only when owner and epoch match and now < lease_until. Rejected completion writes no result and sends no completion event. Completion event is an outbox row in that transaction; dispatcher may deliver duplicate notifications. Consumer deduplicates event_id. Fence prevents stale database publication, not duplicate computation. External payment call before completion is not fenced by this design; this service currently has no payment integration. Five staging cases exercised stale epoch, expiry boundary, valid completion, renewal failure, duplicate outbox delivery. No production run is recorded. Historical prototype used wall clock from worker and stored owner only; deployed staging implementation no longer does. Future proposal: cancel local computation on lost renewal; not implemented.

checks: old worker can compute but cannot publish
duplicate outbox possible and event_id dedup
external side effects not protected; staging only

files.notes.md: Command names and order are contractual. Current read alias catalog-live points to idx-v41; new idx-v42 exists. No change to writes during this procedure. First run indexctl inspect idx-v42. Require build_state=ready AND missing_docs=0 AND checksum_ok=true. null in any required field is unknown and blocks transition. If precheck fails, stop; fix/build process is outside this procedure. Run indexctl compare --from idx-v41 --to idx-v42 --sample 500. Require mismatches<=2; at 2 continue; missing report blocks. Then indexctl freeze-alias catalog-live. If freeze fails stop without switching. Re-run indexctl inspect idx-v42 after freeze with the same ready/0/true gate. If this second check fails, indexctl unfreeze-alias catalog-live and stop, no switch. If gate passes, indexctl switch catalog-live idx-v42 --expected idx-v41. If expected alias differs, switch rejects; unfreeze and stop, do not force. Successful switch must be followed by indexctl probe catalog-live; require errors=0 on 100 queries. Failure or missing probe means rollback: indexctl switch catalog-live idx-v41 --expected idx-v42, then unfreeze, then stop and escalate to search on-call. Successful probe: unfreeze, finish. If rollback itself fails, keep freeze, escalate; do not unfreeze. Unfreeze failure is escalated without further actions. Commands shown do not delete either index.

files.notes.md: Auth verifier snapshot: signing key K2 is active since 14:00 UTC. K1 is verify-only until 14:30 UTC exclusive. Verification requires known kid, valid signature, aud=console, exp strictly greater than verification time. Token with exp=14:30 expires at 14:30 even if K2 signed it. K1 token with exp=14:45 fails after 14:30 because K1 retired. Each verifier polls keyset every 60 seconds; there is no push invalidation. Local keyset older than 120 seconds causes verification to fail closed (503 keyset_stale), not unauthorized. At age exactly120 seconds it is still usable. Unknown kid triggers one synchronous keyset refresh per request. If refresh fails return503 keyset_refresh_failed; if refresh succeeds and kid remains unknown return401 unknown_kid. This does not mean retrying application requests is safe; write API idempotency is separate. A K1 token cannot be re-signed by client; token issuer must issue a new token. Audit sample in test environment covers signed-token acceptance and both stale/refetch failure branches; no production success rate available. Proposed future cache push is not implemented. No private key material is in this note.

Success: ledgerctl resume B73 --after 2400. If resume returns ambiguous timeout, do not repeat it. Run ledgerctl status B73. If running=true, monitor; if running=false or unknown, leave lock and escalate. files.notes.md: Asset API delete uses tombstones. DELETE /assets/a first checks access; missing or already tombstoned returns204 without inserting another deletion event. Existing active object: transaction sets deleted_at and inserts outbox event. Response204 after commit, not after blob removal. GET detail consults primary database and returns404 for tombstoned object immediately after that commit. Search index updated asynchronously by id+revision; older update with lower revision is rejected. Search can list tombstoned object until indexing catches up; no maximum delay guaranteed. Detail link then404 is expected consistency boundary. Blob purge scheduled24hours after deleted_at; purge worker may run later. During retention authorized recovery POST /assets/a/restore allowed only before purge_started=true. Clock under24hours alone does not establish recovery availability; legal_hold=true prevents purge indefinitely but doesn't extend API access to unauthorized callers. Restore increments revision and creates outbox event; stale delete index event cannot override newer revision. Purge_started true permanently blocks restore even if blob still physically exists. Backup deletion schedule unspecified. Historical screenshot shows delayed search but does not measure current delay. No guarantee that204means irreversible erase.

If fail or missing report, certctl discard-stage ingress-a then stop. If pass, certctl activate ingress-a c18 --expect c17. After successful activation, certctl probe ingress-a --live, require handshake_errors=0 AND checked_regions=3. If fail/unknown, run certctl activate ingress-a c17 --expect c18. If rollback succeeds, run certctl probe ingress-a --live to validate old cert with same errors0/regions3 gate. Failed rollback or failed/unknown old-cert probe: contact network on-call and leave state as is. No instructions to restart service. If initial new-cert liveprobe passes, certctl clear-stage ingress-a then finish. Failure of clear-stage escalated without repeating activation. Never delete c17 in this procedure. Rollback-supported window ends only in separate future retirement task, not21days.
